item.title: Ancient temple rich with gold and ritual altars unearthed on Evia island
item.description: Archaeologists working on the Greek island of Evia have uncovered a previously unknown ancient temple.

item.title: Greece moves up Europe's mortgage rankings
item.description: Greece ranked among the five most affordable countries in the euro area for mortgage borrowing in November 2025.

item.title: John Doulgeridis' Carlisle Homes among Australia's quiet profit giants
item.description: John Doulgeridis is among a new wave of reclusive entrepreneurs whose success has only recently been quantified.

item.title: From Kythera to Boston: The Greek pianist setting fire to classical music
item.description: Kyriakopoulos has already carved out a career that places him amongst the most promising Greek pianists with international acclaim.

item.title: Greece rolls out digital passport system to speed up applications and boost security
item.description: Greece has introduced a new digital platform that modernises the way passport applications are processed.

item.title: Rare 3rd millennium BC burial discovered during excavations in Rafina, Attica
item.description: A highly significant Early Bronze Age pithos burial, dating from 3200 to 2000 BC, has been uncovered in Rafina.

item.title: Mediterranean diet health benefits update with new info
item.description: By Lisa Radinovsky from Greek Liquid Gold. The health benefits of the Mediterranean diet have earned it widespread fame, from social media and TV to cookbooks and conferences. item.title: South Melbourne FC defeat Tahiti United in OFC Pro League clash
item.description: A late free-kick secured South Melbourne FC a 2–1 victory over Tahiti United in a dramatic Match Day 2 clash at the OFC Pro League.

item.title: Greece and Cyprus invited to join Gaza Peace Council
item.description: Greece and Cyprus have been invited by US President Donald Trump to join a Peace Council overseeing Gaza’s temporary governance.

item.title: Greek PM Mitsotakis to meet farmers’ committee as protests continue
item.description: Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis will host a new round of talks on Monday with a 25-member committee representing farmers.
